description: This file defines a SettingsFragment class for an Android app, which manages user toggles for AI, Bluetooth, and Wi-Fi features, and handles permissions request via a button.

classes.name: SettingsFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that provides a UI for toggling settings and requesting permissions.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up switch listeners to store preferences and a button listener to request permissions.
